x-contract.canonical_json: ASCII sorted keys separators comma/colon exactly one terminal newline

mandatory_semantic_rules.S01_external_trust: Admission and final head hash must come from root's independently trusted run map; manifest_relative_path must equal bundle_directory/manifest.json. Valid self-asserted JSON or internally supplied hashes confer no trust.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S02_files_and_tensor_bytes: Exact six regular single-link files; verify trusted manifest then all bytes/lengths/finite f32 tensor data and semantic digests before native allocation/copy; descriptor names/offsets equal catalog.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S03_cross_identity: Manifest/provenance/admission/reference epochs, component hashes, schema/catalog/config/source/environment/data identities agree exactly. Schema SHA is external; no self-hash field inside schema registry.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S04_validation: Exactly ordered rows; tp+fp+fn+tn=9900; precision/recall/F1/accuracy use frozen zero-division0 formulas; mean uses math.fsum(row F1)/256. Compare exact same-runtime JSON scalar results, no new tolerance.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S05_epoch_counters: Candidate epoch=provenance complete_epochs=validation_epochs; completed_updates=attempted_updates=epoch*2559 for a complete candidate; no partial epoch selectable; later failed counters live outside immutable candidate.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S06_initialization: Require role-specific seeding/post-model-RNG/negative-generator references and actual trusted primitive evidence bytes/hash; missing records fail. Hash references are provenance only; never restore RNG.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S07_history: Decision sequence=epoch=last_epoch, consecutive1..E; first selects, later selects iff candidate_f1>prior best, ties retain earliest. Chain previous receipt/selected/best exactly; finalization sequence=E+1 and last_epoch=E once.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S08_transaction: Receipt->previous receipt; pointer->receipt; intent->next receipt/pointer and prior head; atomic head->intent/receipt/pointer is sole commit. On retain selected alias/object unchanged. Preserve immutable versions; no hash cycles or retry after failure.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S09_finalized_load: Trusted final head, receipt, pointer alias/object and reference agree before strict dual-component load. Native observation/source/mode/alias checks required. No optimizer/RNG/terminal-state-as-start restore.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S10_terminal_state: Saved state fixed epoch-final weights after zero reset and existing eval consumes0..2815. Full hidden/cell each51200 bytes and chronology match; no training carry substituted.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S11_test_attempt: Charge terminal attempt before selected load. Event sequence begins charged; load->replay->testread->complete only or failure; no reopening even on load/budget/parity failure. Root admission and frozen stop policy separately govern whether test may run.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S12_replay: Observe existing final replay0..2815 and compare exact H+C bytes/semantic digests with saved s2816 before advancing lazy test iterator. No extra cell/head calls for parity hash check.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S13_paths_and_canonical: Canonical ASCII JSON sorted keys compact separators plus newline, no duplicate keys, exact built-in ints excluding bools, finite numbers; depth<=8/objectkeys<=64/stringbytes<=256/integer-token-digits<=10/number-token-chars<=64. Parse valid UTC calendar timestamps. Paths relative to root-trusted run directory with no links/traversal; external refs read bounded stable bytes.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S14_digest_domains: Tensor semantic SHA=SHA256(ASCII tgrab-tensor-v1 + NUL + canonical {component,name,dtype,shape,order,nbytes} + tensor bytes). File SHA separate. Component semantic SHA hashes canonical ordered [name,semantic_sha256] pairs with tgrab-component-v1+NUL domain.
mandatory_semantic_rules.S15_implicit_encodings: Node-order, feature and weight encoding semantic SHA use tgrab-node-order-v1/tgrab-feature-encoding-v1/tgrab-weight-encoding-v1 plus NUL and canonical fixed descriptors specified in human protocol; these identify implicit encodings, not an observed numerical feature tensor.
